name: dotnetdupe
description: A modern, cross-platform C++ Base Class Library (BCL) bringing the elegance, productivity, and familiar APIs of .NET to C++.

paragraphs: Ever admired the elegance and developer-friendliness of .NET APIs? 🤔 While the C++ Standard Template Library (STL) is powerful, its learning curve can be steep. This project, DotNetDupe, bridges that gap! 🌉
Inspired by the clear and concise API design of C# .NET, DotNetDupe is a C++ library that brings a familiar, streamlined development experience to your C++ projects. ✨

Latest Published Version ([]( Comprehensive documentation, API reference updates, Pimpl ABI stability, and refined packaging! 🌐 Key highlights include: - 💾 Drive Metrics & Free Space Telemetry (System::IO::DriveInfo): Full drive metrics, file system format, volume label, total size, and available/free space queries via DriveInfo::GetDrives(), GetTotalSize(), GetTotalFreeSpace(), and GetAvailableFreeSpace(). - 📂 Recursive Directory Searching (System::IO::Directory & SearchOption): Added SearchOption::TopDirectoryOnly and SearchOption::AllDirectories overloads to Directory::GetFiles,…
features: SmartPointer: Exception-safe RAII reference-counted smart pointer with NewShared() and NewUnique() factory helpers.
Base Object type system with ToString(), GetType(), Equals(), and GetHashCode().
EventHandler: Multicast event delegate supporting lambda, free function, and member method binding with operator+=, token unsubscription with operator-=, and FIFO invocation.
